name: Tiny example section
description: Defines the README section that shows a small source spec example.
heading: A tiny example
intro: Instead of leaving an important rule only in prose, give it a stable Lattice ID.
example:
{
  "id": "REPORT-RULE-NNN",
  "type": "business_rule",
  "name": "Date-only reports use UTC",
  "owner": "reporting",
  "status": "active",
  "description": "Defines how date-only values are displayed in generated reports.",
  "statement": "Date-only report fields must be formatted using UTC semantics, not local browser timezone semantics.",
  "tests": ["REPORT-VERIFY-NNN"]
}
outro: Docs, tests, generated LLM context, review comments, and implementation plans can point to the same rule ID instead of rewriting the rule in five places.
